name: Guildias
source:
The man responsible for [url=/c10893]Guys[/url]' misfortunes, Guildias is a paranoid and corrupt policeman. However, Guys isn't the first person Guildias has contributed to the false imprisonment of; Guildias has unjustly arrested and assisted in the imprisonment of a variety of others.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
